button._doc: Drives DUT button membrane line. LOW=pressed, HIGH=released. DUT has internal pull-up.

peltier._doc: MOSFET gate driving peltier heater element near MLX90614 IR temp sensor. HIGH=heat on. Simulates skin temperature for on-body detection threshold. temp_adc_channel is a fixture-side NTC thermistor near the peltier to verify heating (reads via ADC, not the DUT's MLX90614).

charger_relay._doc: Relay switching ch1 PSU (5V) to DUT VCHG input. HIGH=relay closed (charger connected). Only enable when battery_installed=true.

ppg_simulator._doc: IR blocker servo + green LED array. Blocked=IR absorbed (no touch). Exposed=IR reflects off green LED PCB (touch detected). HR LED toggles green LEDs at heart-rate frequency. BLOCKED: Needs PWM RPC in MTIB V1 proto.

led_sensor._doc: Photodiodes over DUT status LEDs. ADC ch 4-6 not connected on current fixture.

nfc_reader._doc: NFC reader for DUT NFC antenna verification. I2C not wired.

motion._doc: FluidNC linear rail for accelerometer stimulus. Not connected to validation MTIBs.

_hardware_notes.swd_gpios: GPIO 0+1 are RESERVED for SWD level shifter enable (always output LOW). Never assign to fixture.
_hardware_notes.pwm_pins: GPIO 7=PWM_1 (SODIMM_15), GPIO 8=PWM_2 (SODIMM_16). Connected to Verdin iMX8MM PWM outputs.
_hardware_notes.manufacturing_adc: ch0=power rail (~4.5V), ch1=battery divider (~2.5V), ch2=backup rail (~4.5V), ch3=SYS (~0V unused), ch7=3.3V ref
